$comment: What the engine does with each property the corpus declares. A property that appears in a case
and not here fails the build, which is the point: the risk in a renderer is not the feature it
knows it lacks but the one a page started relying on while nobody looked.
States: 'modelled' - read and acted on; 'partial' - read, and wrong in the cases the note names;
'unsupported' - never read. Anything but 'modelled' has to carry a reason.

properties.background-attachment: unsupported: a background is painted where its own box is; 'fixed' and 'local' are not told apart
properties.background-origin: unsupported: the positioning area is always the padding box
properties.background-position-x: partial: the engine asks for 'background-position', which the cascade only ever carries as this pair, so a declared offset is lost and a sprite sheet is drawn whole into its box
properties.background-position-y: partial: the other half of the same miss as background-position-x
properties.background-repeat-x: partial: split into this pair by the cascade, so the 'no-repeat' a page declares never arrives and every layer tiles
properties.background-repeat-y: partial: the other half of the same miss as background-repeat-x
properties.column-gap: partial: read as the space between flex and grid tracks; it asks for nothing in a page that has no multi-column, which the engine does not implement
properties.font-stretch: unsupported: no typeface is selected by its width
properties.font-variant: unsupported: small caps and the rest of the variant stack are not applied
properties.overflow: modelled: the box clips and reports its scrollable extent; scrolling itself is the host's
properties.row-gap: partial: read as the space between flex and grid tracks, and as nothing else
properties.rule: modelled: AngleSharp expands it into the six per-axis rule longhands, so a longhand written after it still answers its own axis
properties.text-emphasis: modelled: the shorthand of the marks a run is drawn with, read token by token beside the longhands
properties.text-emphasis-style: modelled: the shape or string each marked character takes, and whether it is filled or open
properties.text-emphasis-color: modelled: the colour the marks are drawn in, or the box's ink where none is named
properties.text-emphasis-position: modelled: the edge of the line the marks stand against, read for a column from right and left
properties.text-emphasis-skip: modelled: which characters go unmarked; `auto` leaves the spaces and the narrow punctuation alone
